Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) {}\n57: \n58:     Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }\n59:     Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }\n60:     Vec3 operator*(val_t s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }\n61:     Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }\n62:     Vec3 operator-() const { return return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }\n90:     Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }\n91: \n92:     val_t area() const {\n93:         Vec3 ab = b - a;\n94:         Vec3 ac = c - a;\n95:         return 0.5f * triangle normal\n132:     Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n133:     val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n134:     val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n135:               boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n136:               boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n137:     if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n138: \n139:     // Test 9 edge cross products\n140:     auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n141:         val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n142:         val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n143:         val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n144:         val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n145:                   boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n146:                   boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n147:         auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n148:         return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n149:     };\n150: \n151:     Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n152:     Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n153:     for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n154:         for std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n178:     const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n179: \n180:     Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181: \n182:     void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183:         allTriangles = &triangles;\n184:         if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185: \n186:         // Compute bounding box\n187:         minBound = triangles[0].a;\n188:         maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n189:         for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n190:             for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191:                 minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192:                 minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193:                 minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n194:                 maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n195:                 maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n196:                 maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n197:             }\n198:         }\n199: \n200:         // Collect all indices\n201:         std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n202:         for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n203: \n204:         buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n205:     }\n206: \n207: private:\n208:     void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n209:         minBound = nodeMin;\n210:         maxBound = nodeMax;\n211:         halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n212:         center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213: \n214:         // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215:         if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216:             (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217:             triangleIndices = indices;\n218:             return;\n219:         }\n220: \n221:         // Subdivide into 8 children\n222:         Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223:         std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224: \n225:         for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226:             const Triangle& tri =              }\n238:             }\n239:         }\n240: \n241:         // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242:         bool canSplit = false;\n243:         for (int i = }\n248:         }\n249: \n250:         if (!canSplit) {\n251:             triangleIndices = indices;\n252:             return;\n253:         }\n254: \n255:         // Build children\n256:         for (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282:         if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283:         if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284: \n285:         if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286:         if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287:         if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288: \n289:         return true;\n290:     }\n291: \n292:     // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293:     // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294:     template<typename Func>\n295:     bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296:         // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297:         if 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346:             {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347:             {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348:         };\n349: \n350:         // Subdivide\n351:         for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352:             std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353:             std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354: \n355:             auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356:                 auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357:                 auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358:                 if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359: \n360:                 Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361:                 mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362:                 idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363:                 vertices.push_back(mid);\n364:                 midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365:                 return idx;\n366:             };\n367: \n368:             for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369:                 idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370:                 idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371:                 idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372: \n373:                 newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374:                 newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375:                 newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376:                 newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377:             }\n378:             faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379:         }\n380: \n381:         // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382:         triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383:         for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384:             // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385:             triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386:         }\n387:     }\n388: };\n389: \n390: // ============================================================================\n391: // Random Number Generation\n392: // ============================================================================\n393: \n394: class RandomGenerator {\n395:     std::mt19937 rng;\n396:     std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397: public:\n398:     explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399:     val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400: };\n401: \n402: // Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403: Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404:     val_t u = rng.rand();\n405:     val_t v = rng.rand();\n406:     if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407:         u = 1.0f - u;\n408:         v = 1.0f - v;\n409:     }\n410:     Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411:     Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412:     return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413: }\n414: \n415: // ============================================================================\n416: // Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417: // ============================================================================\n418: \n419: val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420:                             const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421:     Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422:     Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423:     Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424:     val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425: \n426:     if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427: \n428:     val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429:     Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430:     val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431:     if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432: \n433:     Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434:     val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435:     if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436: \n437:     return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438: }\n439: \n440: // ============================================================================\n441: // Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442: // ============================================================================\n443: \n444: // Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445: // Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446: bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447:                   const Octree& octree,\n448:                   size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449:     Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450:     val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451:     if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452:     Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453: \n454:     return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455:         if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456: \n457:         val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458:         if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459:             return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460:         }\n461:         return false;\n462:     });\n463: }\n464: \n465: // ============================================================================\n466: // Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467: // ============================================================================\n468: \n469: // Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470: val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471:     val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472:     if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473:     return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474: }\n475: \n476: // Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477: val_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478:                   const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479:                   const Octree& octree,\n480:                   RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481:     const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482:     const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483: \n484:     // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485:     if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486: \n487:     val_t kij = ZERO;\n488: \n489:     for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490:         Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491:         Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492: \n493:         if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494: \n495:         Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496:         val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497:         if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498: \n499:         val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500:         val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501: \n502:         if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503: \n504:         kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505:     }\n506: \n507:     return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508: }\n509: \n510: // ============================================================================\n511: // Tau (time delay) Computation\n512: // ============================================================================\n513: \n514: int computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515:     val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516:     return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517: }\n518: \n519: // ============================================================================\n520: // Room Response Simulation State\n521: // ============================================================================\n522: \n523: struct SimulationState {\n524:     size_t numTriangles;\n525: to 1.0)\n530:     std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531:     std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532:     std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533:     std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534:     std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535: \n536:     Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537: \n538:     size_t sourceIndex;\n539: \n540:     size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541:     size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542: };\n543: \n544: // ============================================================================\n545: // Initialization\n546: // ============================================================================\n547: \n548: void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549:                           size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550:     // Generate mesh\n551: octree for spatial acceleration\n560:     printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561:     state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562: \n563:     // Initialize areas\n564: reflectivity\n570:     state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n571: \n572:     // Initialize matrices\n573:     state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574: timesteps / 2;\n582:     for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583:         state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584:     }\n585: }\n586: \n587: // triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603:         }\n604:     }\n605: }\n606: \n607: void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608:     printf(\"Computing time delays ============================================================================\n622: \n623: void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624:     printf(\"Running wave propagation \n630:             for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631:                 if (i == j) continue;\n632: \n633:                 int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634: \n635: j)];\n639:                 if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640: \n641:                 // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642:                 size_t srcTime = t - cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666: \n667:     for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668:         val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669:         int bestT = 0;\n670: \n671:         // Discrete validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696:     printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697: \n698:     // Check that distances are non-negative\n699:     bool allNonNegative = true;\n700:     val_t }\n762: \n763:     if (!allNonNegative) {\n764:         return false;\n765:     }\n766: \n767:     printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n768:     return true;\n769: }\n770: \n771: // {}\n\n    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }\n    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }\n\n    val_t area() const {\n        Vec3 ab = b - a;\n        Vec3 ac = c - a;\n        return 0.5f * ab.cross(ac).norm();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Triangle& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\npublic:\n    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh Wave propagation using radiosity equations with time delays (Tau)\n * 3. Distance estimation via cross-correlation of radiosity values\n * \n * The implementation generates a procedural icosphere mesh to simulate a room.\n *\n * GPU parallelization:\n *  - Time delays (Tau): one thread per (i, j) triangle pair.\n *  - Form factors (Kij): the host generates the random sample stream in exactly\n *    the same order as the sequential algorithm (one shared mt19937 stream,\n *    64 draws per non-culled pair) and streams it in chunks to the device, where\n *    one thread evaluates one pair. Visibility uses the octree flattened into\n *    device arrays and traversed with an explicit stack.\n *  - Wave propagation: timesteps are sequential (tau >= 1 for distinct triangles),\n *    but within a timestep one thread per receiving triangle i performs the sum\n *    over j in the original order, so results are identical to the sequential code.\n *  - Cross-correlation: one thread per (triangle, lag) pair, followed by a\n *    per-triangle argmax kernel.\n */\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <array>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <chrono>\n#include std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                          \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Types and Constants\n// ============================================================================\n\nusing idx_t = uint32_t;\nusing val_t = float;\n\nconstexpr val_t PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;\nconstexpr val_t ZERO = 0.0f;\nconstexpr val_t ONE = 1.0f;\nconstexpr val_t WAVE_SPEED = 0.5f;        // Wave propagation speed (units per timestep)\nconstexpr val_t INV_WAVE_SPEED = 1.0f / WAVE_SPEED;\nconstexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling\nconstexpr val_t const {\n        val_t n = norm();\n        return n > EPSILON ? *this / n : Vec3();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return std::abs(x - o.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - o.y) < EPSILON && std::abs(z - o.z) < EPSILON;\n    }\n};\n\nstruct Triangle {\n    Vec3 a, b, c;\n    Vec3 _normal;\n\n    Triangle() = default;\n    Triangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c)\n        : a(a), b(b), c(c), _normal((b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()) {}\n\n    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }\n    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }\n\n    val_t std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n return {a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x};\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dSqNorm(Vf a) { return a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y + a.z * a.z; }\n__device__ if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > nd.half.x * ad.y + nd.half.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Is the segment from->to blocked by any triangle other than src/dst?\n__device__ bool dIsRayBlocked(Vf from, Vf to, const DTri* tris, const DNode* nodes,\n                              const uint32_t* triList, uint32_t srcIdx, uint32_t dstIdx) {\n    Vf dir = dSub(to, from);\n    float rayLen = dNorm(dir);\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vf dirNorm = dDivS(dir, rayLen);\n\n    int32_t stack[OCTREE_STACK_CAP];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // root node\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const DNode& nd = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (nd.leaf) {\n            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < nd.triCount; ++k) {\n                uint32_t idx = triList[nd.triBegin + k];\n                if (idx == srcIdx || idx == dstIdx) continue;\n                const DTri& tri = tris[idx];\n                float dist = dRayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int32_t ch = nd.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && dRayIntersectsBox(nodes[ch], from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = ch;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Time delay for every ordered pair; stored transposed: tauT[j*n + i] = tau(i, j)\n__global__ void timeDelayKernel(const DTri* __restrict__ tris, int* __restrict__ tauT, uint32_t n) {\n    uint64_t k = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    uint64_t total = static_cast<uint64_t>(n) * n;\n    if (k >= total) return;\n\n    uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(k / n);\n    uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(k - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n);\n\n    int tau = 0;\n    if (i != j) {\n        const DTri& ti = tris[i];\n        const DTri& tj = tris[j];\n        Vf ci = dDivS(dAdd(dAdd(ti.a, ti.b), ti.c), 3.0f);\n        Vf cj = dDivS(dAdd(dAdd(tj.a, tj.b), tj.c), 3.0f);\n        float dist = dNorm(dSub(ci, cj));\n        tau = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n    }\n    tauT[static_cast<uint64_t>(j) * n + i] = tau;\n}\n\n// Form factor for a batch of non-culled pairs. Thread k handles pair pairs[k]\n// using DRAWS_PER_PAIR uniform samples at draws[k * DRAWS_PER_PAIR ...].\n// Writes kijT[j*n + i] = Kij(i, j).\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(const DTri* __restrict__ tris, const DNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                 const uint32_t* __restrict__ triList,\n                                 const uint2* __restrict__ pairs, const float* __restrict__ draws,\n                                 uint32_t count, uint32_t n, float* __restrict__ kijT) {\n    uint32_t k = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (k >= count) return;\n\n    const uint32_t i = pairs[k].x;\n    const uint32_t j = pairs[k].y;\n    const DTri& triI = tris[i];\n    const DTri& triJ = tris[j];\n    const float* u = draws + static_cast<size_t>(k) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n\n    float kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vf pI = dRandomPointInTriangle(triI, u[r * 4 + 0], u[r * 4 + 1]);\n        Vf pJ = dRandomPointInTriangle(triJ, u[r * 4 + 2], u[r * 4 + 3]);\n\n        if (dIsRayBlocked(pI, pJ, tris, nodes, triList, i, j)) continue;\n\n        Vf v = dSub(pJ, pI);\n        float distSqr = dSqNorm(v);\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        // cosPhi(v, triI.normal) and cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal)\n        float vNormI = dNorm(v);\n        float cosPhiI = ZERO;\n        if (vNormI > EPSILON) {\n            float x = dDot(v, triI.n) / vNormI;\n            cosPhiI = (ZERO < x) ? x : ZERO;\n        }\n        Vf negV = dNeg(v);\n        float vNormJ = dNorm(negV);\n        float cosPhiJ = ZERO;\n        if (vNormJ > EPSILON) {\n            float x = dDot(negV, triJ.n) / vNormJ;\n            cosPhiJ = (ZERO < x) ? x : ZERO;\n        }\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    kijT[static_cast<size_t>(j) * n + i] = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// Wave propagation for one timestep. Thread i computes radB[t][i] with the\n// sum over j performed in the same order as the sequential algorithm.\n__global__ void simulationStepKernel(const int* __restrict__ tauT, const float* __restrict__ kijT,\n                                     const float* __restrict__ areas, const float* __restrict__ rho,\n                                     const float* __restrict__ radE, float* __restrict__ radB,\n                                     uint32_t n, int t) {\n    uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n\n    float sumB = ZERO;\n    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        if (i == j) continue;\n\n        const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(j) * n + i;\n        int tauij = tauT[off];\n\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n\n        float kij = kijT[off];\n        if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n        size_t srcTime = static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij);\n        float radJ = radB[srcTime * n + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        sumB += fminf(kij * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(t) * n + i;\n    radB[off] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[off];\n}\n\n// Cross-correlation sums: corr[i*T + t] = sum_{tt>=t} radB[tt][src] * radB[tt-t][...]\n__global__ void correlationKernel(const float* __restrict__ radB, float* __restrict__ corr,\n                                  uint32_t n, uint32_t T, uint32_t src) {\n    uint64_t k = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    uint64_t total = static_cast<uint64_t>(n) * T;\n    if (k >= total) return;\n\n    uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(k / T);\n    uint32_t t = static_cast<uint32_t>(k - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * T);\n\n    float sum = ZERO;\n    for (uint32_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n        float pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * n + i];\n        float pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * n + src];\n        sum += pS * pB;\n    }\n    corr[k] = sum;\n}\n\n// Per-triangle argmax over lags (first maximum wins, as in the sequential code)\n__global__ void argmaxKernel(const float* __restrict__ corr, float* __restrict__ distances,\n                             uint32_t n, uint32_t T) {\n    uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n\n    float maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (uint32_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        float sum = corr[static_cast<size_t>(i) * T + t];\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n        }\n    }\n    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<float>(bestT);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N, row-major; host copy for validation)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix; host copy for validation)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure (host build)\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// Device-resident simulation data and staging buffers\nstruct DeviceState {\n    DTri* tris = nullptr;\n    DNode* nodes = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* triList = nullptr;\n    float* areas = nullptr;\n    float* rho = nullptr;\n    float* radE = nullptr;\n    float* radB = nullptr;\n    float* kijT = nullptr;   // transposed form factors: kijT[j*n + i] = Kij(i, j)\n    int* tauT = nullptr;     // transposed time delays:   tauT[j*n + i] = Tau(i, j)\n    float* corr = nullptr;\n    float* distances = nullptr;\n\n    // Double-buffered form-factor staging (pinned host, device)\n    float* hostDraws[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    uint2* hostPairs[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    float* devDraws[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    uint2* devPairs[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    cudaStream_t streams[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Flatten the host octree into device-friendly arrays (depth-first, root = 0)\nint flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<DNode>& nodes, std::vector<uint32_t>& triList,\n                  int depth, int& maxDepth) {\n    maxDepth = std::max(maxDepth, depth);\n    int id = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());\n    nodes.push_back(DNode{});\n\n    DNode d{};\n    d.center = {node.center.x, node.center.y, node.center.z};\n    d.half = {node.halfExtent.x, node.halfExtent.y, node.halfExtent.z};\n    for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) d.child[c] = -1;\n\n    if (!node.triangleIndices.empty()) {\n        d.leaf = 1;\n        d.triBegin = static_cast<uint32_t>(triList.size());\n        for (size_t idx : node.triangleIndices) triList.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));\n        d.triCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(node.triangleIndices.size());\n    } else {\n        for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n            if (node.children[c]) {\n                d.child[c] = flattenOctree(*node.children[c], nodes, triList, depth + 1, maxDepth);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    nodes[id] = d;\n    return id;\n}\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize emission / radiosity buffers\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.clear();\n    state.kij.clear();\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// Allocate device buffers and upload the static simulation data\nvoid setupDevice(const SimulationState& state, DeviceState& dev) {\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // Triangles\n    std::vector<DTri> hTris(n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[i];\n        hTris[i].a = {t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z};\n        hTris[i].b = {t.b.x, t.b.y, t.b.z};\n        hTris[i].c = {t.c.x, t.c.y, t.c.z};\n        Vec3 nrm = t.normal();\n        hTris[i].n = {nrm.x, nrm.y, nrm.z};\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.tris, n * sizeof(DTri)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.tris, hTris.data(), n * sizeof(DTri), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Octree\n    std::vector<DNode> hNodes;\n    std::vector<uint32_t> hTriList;\n    int maxDepth = 0;\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, hNodes, hTriList, 0, maxDepth);\n    if (8 * (maxDepth + 1) + 1 > OCTREE_STACK_CAP) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree depth %d exceeds traversal stack capacity\\n\", maxDepth);\n        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.nodes, hNodes.size() * sizeof(DNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.nodes, hNodes.data(), hNodes.size() * sizeof(DNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.triList, hTriList.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.triList, hTriList.data(), hTriList.size() * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Per-triangle data\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.areas, n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.areas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.rho, n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.rho, state.rho.data(), n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.distances, n * sizeof(float)));\n\n    // Matrices\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.kijT, n * n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.kijT, 0, n * n * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.tauT, n * n * sizeof(int)));\n\n    // Radiosity\n    const size_t radBytes = std::max<size_t>(T * n, 1) * sizeof(float);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.radE, radBytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.radB, radBytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.radB, 0, radBytes));\n    if (T * n > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.radE, state.radE.data(), T * n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    // Correlation buffer\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.corr, std::max<size_t>(n * T, 1) * sizeof(float)));\n\n    // Form-factor staging\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&dev.hostDraws[b], PAIRS_PER_CHUNK * DRAWS_PER_PAIR * sizeof(float)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&dev.hostPairs[b], PAIRS_PER_CHUNK * sizeof(uint2)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.devDraws[b], PAIRS_PER_CHUNK * DRAWS_PER_PAIR * sizeof(float)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.devPairs[b], PAIRS_PER_CHUNK * sizeof(uint2)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&dev.streams[b]));\n    }\n}\n\nvoid destroyDevice(DeviceState& dev) {\n    cudaFree(dev.tris);\n    cudaFree(dev.nodes);\n    cudaFree(dev.triList);\n    cudaFree(dev.areas);\n    cudaFree(dev.rho);\n    cudaFree(dev.radE);\n    cudaFree(dev.radB);\n    cudaFree(dev.kijT);\n    cudaFree(dev.tauT);\n    cudaFree(dev.corr);\n    cudaFree(dev.distances);\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        cudaFreeHost(dev.hostDraws[b]);\n        cudaFreeHost(dev.hostPairs[b]);\n        cudaFree(dev.devDraws[b]);\n        cudaFree(dev.devPairs[b]);\n        cudaStreamDestroy(dev.streams[b]);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Same culling rule as the sequential algorithm: triangles facing the same way\n// contribute nothing and consume no random samples.\nbool isCulled(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    return triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f;\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(const SimulationState& state, DeviceState& dev) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    const uint64_t total = static_cast<uint64_t>(state.numTriangles) * state.numTriangles;\n    if (total == 0) return;\n    const unsigned int block = 256;\n    const unsigned int grid = static_cast<unsigned int>((total + block - 1) / block);\n    timeDelayKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dev.tris, dev.tauT, static_cast<uint32_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(const SimulationState& state, DeviceState& dev) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    if (n == 0) return;\n\n    // A single RNG stream, consumed in the same order as the sequential code:\n    // row-major over (i, j), skipping i == j and culled pairs.\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    size_t i = 0;\n    size_t j = 0;\n    int chunk = 0;\n\n    while (i < n) {\n        const int b = chunk & 1;\n        ++chunk;\n\n        // Wait until the previous kernel using this staging buffer has finished\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(dev.streams[b]));\n\n        float* hDraws = dev.hostDraws[b];\n        uint2* hPairs = dev.hostPairs[b];\n        size_t count = 0;\n\n        while (count < PAIRS_PER_CHUNK && i < n) {\n            if (i != j && !isCulled(state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j])) {\n                hPairs[count] = make_uint2(static_cast<unsigned int>(i), static_cast<unsigned int>(j));\n                float* d = hDraws + count * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n                for (int k = 0; k < DRAWS_PER_PAIR; ++k) {\n                    d[k] = rng.rand();\n                }\n                ++count;\n            }\n\n            ++j;\n            if (j == n) {\n                j = 0;\n                if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == n) {\n                    printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, n);\n                }\n                ++i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (count == 0) continue;\n\n        cudaStream_t s = dev.streams[b];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dev.devPairs[b], hPairs, count * sizeof(uint2),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dev.devDraws[b], hDraws, count * DRAWS_PER_PAIR * sizeof(float),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n\n        const unsigned int block = 128;\n        const unsigned int grid = static_cast<unsigned int>((count + block - 1) / block);\n        formFactorKernel<<<grid, block, 0, s>>>(dev.tris, dev.nodes, dev.triList,\n                                                dev.devPairs[b], dev.devDraws[b],\n                                                static_cast<uint32_t>(count),\n                                                static_cast<uint32_t>(n), dev.kijT);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(dev.streams[b]));\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(const SimulationState& state, DeviceState& dev) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const uint32_t n = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.numTriangles);\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    if (n == 0) return;\n\n    const unsigned int block = 128;\n    const unsigned int grid = (n + block - 1) / block;\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        simulationStepKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dev.tauT, dev.kijT, dev.areas, dev.rho, dev.radE,\n                                              dev.radB, n, static_cast<int>(t));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(const SimulationState& state, DeviceState& dev, std::vector<val_t>& outDistances) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const uint32_t n = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.numTriangles);\n    const uint32_t T = static_cast<uint32_t>(state.numTimesteps);\n    if (n > 0 && T > 0) {\n        const uint64_t total = static_cast<uint64_t>(n) * T;\n        const unsigned int block = 128;\n        const unsigned int grid = static_cast<unsigned int>((total + block - 1) / block);\n        correlationKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dev.radB, dev.corr, n, T,\n                                           static_cast<uint32_t>(state.sourceIndex));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    if (n > 0) {\n        const unsigned int block = 128;\n        const unsigned int grid = (n + block - 1) / block;\n        argmaxKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dev.corr, dev.distances, n, T);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    outDistances.assign(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    if (n > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(outDistances.data(), dev.distances, n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n}\n\n// Copy full matrices back to the host (only needed for validation)\nvoid downloadForValidation(SimulationState& state, const DeviceState& dev) {\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    // kijT is transposed; store as row-major kij[i*n + j] = Kij(i, j)\n    std::vector<float> kijT(n * n);\n    if (n * n > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(kijT.data(), dev.kijT, n * n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n    state.kij.assign(n * n, ZERO);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            state.kij[i * n + j] = kijT[j * n + i];\n        }\n    }\n\n    state.radB.assign(T * n, ZERO);\n    if (T * n > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), dev.radB, T * n * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\" {"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1793063922403,"sessionID":"ses_e8517b04bffeTQ44yXqHUBUK5c","part":{"id":"prt_17aefbfd5001hMOxJzUc08QpR4","messageID":"msg_17aefbb670012RADc08JOerCSQ","sessionID":"ses_e8517b04bffeTQ44yXqHUBUK5c","type":"reasoning","text":"Precomputation takes 6.1 seconds, and the RNG is clearly the bottleneck here. Since multithreading the generator would break the exact stream order without a jump-ahead scheme, I'm instead looking at ways to cut the per-draw host cost of the generator and distribution calls.\n\nThe 3.7 second sys time is puzzling too — could be page faults from pinned memory allocation or the large memset, but I'm not certain. The real win would be parallelizing mt19937 generation via jump-ahead by computing the state at offset positions in the recurrence, letting multiple cores generate disjoint chunks of the sequence that still match the reference exactly.\n\nOne approach: since MT's output bits are linear functions of state over GF(2), I could use Berlekamp-Massey on a sequence of one output bit to recover the characteristic polynomial (degree 19937, known to be primitive), then use that to jump ahead to any position without discarding. It's an elegant exact method but may be more engineering effort than it's worth here.\n\nBut then I'm estimating the cost: computing x^k mod φ for jumps needs multiple polynomial squarings, and doing this per chunk for GPU parallelism adds up to tens of seconds across many chunks. The real bottleneck is that even with jump-ahead solved, each chunk still needs its own MT stream generated in parallel on the GPU, which may require yet another layer of per-thread jumps.\n\nEven chaining jumps between substreams with a precomputed step-size still costs roughly 20ms per substream on the host, so scaling to 100 substreams lands around 2 seconds — not meaningfully faster than the current serial approach, so this jump-ahead strategy doesn't offer a decisive win on its own.\n\nI'm working through whether the minimal polynomial of the state-transition matrix A actually equals φ itself, since the 19968-bit representation has some unused bits that could make the annihilator polynomial larger than the degree-19937 characteristic polynomial of the output sequence — this matters because the jump-ahead formula only works validly if φ(A) truly annihilates every state vector.\n\nI'll stick with the exact, simple, verified approach and just be upfront about the host-RNG bottleneck rather than chase the jump-ahead math further. Since host generation is already overlapped with GPU kernels and host is the critical path, I should check how much GPU time actually costs at scale to see if there's a cheaper win elsewhere.\n\nActually, I suspect the real culprit is that libstdc++'s uniform_real_distribution uses generate_canonical with long double arithmetic, which is notoriously slow -- that's probably eating most of the 6 seconds. Switching to raw mt19937 output and doing the float conversion exactly on the GPU could cut host time substantially, so I want to re-derive libstdc++'s generate_canonical precisely to make sure my GPU-side conversion matches dist(rng) bit-for-bit before committing to that change.\n\nThis confirms my derivation: the float value equals round-to-nearest(raw) times 2^-32, and the distribution just passes this through unchanged since it's scaling by (1-0)+0, with clamping via nextafterf if it ever hits exactly 1.\n\nI want to verify this empirically though — I should write a quick test comparing both conversion paths bitwise across many sample values to make sure the rounding behavior matches between CUDA's uint-to-float conversion and the host's unsigned-to-float conversion.\n\nThinking about raw throughput now: the host's mt19937 generator runs roughly 1-2ns per call, which still puts total generation around 2.5 seconds for the full stream — still host-bound. Since the stream is inherently sequential, I don't see a way to parallelize across host threads or offload the raw MT generation to the GPU without breaking correctness, so I'll stick with the single-threaded host approach and compare the resulting timing against the current ~6.1s baseline.\n\nI'm also considering whether a custom SIMD-vectorized MT19937 could speed things up, since the twist step's internal dependencies are actually far enough apart (distance 397) to allow vectorization — but building and validating a correct SIMD reimplementation against the standard generator feels like a lot of complexity for maybe only a 2-3x gain, so I'm weighing whether it's worth the effort here.\n\nI'll just test empirically instead: compare generating 1e8 raw values versus going through the distribution conversion, and let the measured timings decide whether the extra complexity is justified.\n\n","time":{"start":1793063894997,"end":1793063922318},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}

{"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1793064119854,"sessionID":"ses_e8517b04bffeTQ44yXqHUBUK5c","part":{"id":"prt_17af31804001xMymbgBgkYAiHr","messageID":"msg_17af31326001YRJBhNkmVMY5u1","sessionID":"ses_e8517b04bffeTQ44yXqHUBUK5c","type":"reasoning","text":"I'm thinking about reducing the stack frame size for the traversal by sizing it to the actual max depth needed rather than a fixed large buffer, considering whether a smaller explicit bound like 8*maxDepth+1 would work based on how deep the recursion actually goes for typical configurations.\n\nSince each level can have up to 7 pending siblings, the stack capacity should scale as roughly 7*depth+1. I'm planning to template the kernel on a stack-size parameter so the host can dispatch between a small 64-entry version for shallow trees and the larger 192-entry version when needed, storing maxDepth in device state to drive that choice. The local memory savings might be marginal since low-index accesses likely hit L1 cache anyway, but it's worth testing quickly.\n\n","time":{"start":1793064114180,"end":1793064119780},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}

Occupancy looks fine given the register count, so further gains would need coherence sorting or shared-memory caching of nodes, but those are diminishing returns at this point.\n\nI could try marginal tweaks like forcing __restrict__/__ldg for node reads or precomputing child bounding boxes in the parent to avoid full struct loads, but these feel like minor wins.
